## Summary
Describe the change and its scope. Link related issues if applicable.

## Verification
List commands run, browser flows checked, and results. State anything unverified.
Include screenshots for visual changes, with private information redacted.

## Checklist
- [ ] Read CONTRIBUTING.md and applicable architecture/design guidance.
- [ ] Kept configuration, localization, and generated content aligned.
- [ ] Added or updated behavioral tests where applicable.
- [ ] Ran lint, tests, and a production build, or explained why not.
- [ ] Checked accessibility, mobile layouts, and both themes for UI changes.
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation and Unreleased changelog where applicable.
- [ ] Included no secrets, temporary files, dependencies, or build/test output.
